Do you like flowers, herbs and plants in general? Are you having trouble making friends in the town? Are you tired of urban life and sad men in suits visiting your home? Do you enjoy nature?\nIf any of this is true to you (and I'm sure it is!), please come to the forest during the day. You might meet someone friendly!\n

You don't know me, but your ambitions have caught my eye. You are an interesting person, Mr. Prepper. And there are not many interesting people in the town these days. 
I know that your little road trip didn't go well. Too bad! But if I may suggest something: go big. And don't stick to land route only. I'm attaching something you may find useful. It's a tried and tested design. It might seem crazy at a first glance, but Prepper, I know you can do it. 
And don't be afraid, your secrets are safe with me. And expect more fan mail from me soon!

I hope my letter finds you well. Do you feel inspired by my last gift?
I would like to start a small exchange between us, if you'll agree. From time to time, I will send you a letter or a package with some useful information or an item. And I have access to some rather curious supplies and sources, trust me!
However, there are some things that are hard to obtain for me – and here is where I believe you, Mr. Prepper, would help me. 
You can deliver me things like you would trade them on the local marketplace – I'm sure you'll figure this out.
As an icebreaker - I would just love, love to have a jar of blueberry jam!

How are you? I have recently taken interest in a certain fascinating topic that can also become timely. However, due to regulations of our wise government – bless the President – obtaining reliable sources on this topic is challenging.\nBut Mr. Prepper, you might have more luck! Please deliver me a good book about nuclear warfare and its consequences. Something non-fiction. I am sure I can make up for all the trouble!\nI am not sure where to obtain unusual books these days, given the Agency's pressure. I think the whole book business must have gone underground.

Thank you very much for the book, it was very informative indeed! Now I have a follow-up request: could you bring me a Geiger counter? I am not saying I need to use it right now… but still I would like to learn how to use it, and rather sooner than later. \nThe Geiger counter is already quite an old technology; maybe you'll find one where other old things are?\nI will be grateful!

Thank you very much for the Geiger counter! Now I feel much more… prepared. 
Remember my first gift for you? Have you already started constructing your vehicle? I'm sure you'll handle most of it easily, but keep in mind that such technology requires impeccable quality of elements, hard to achieve in our do-it-yourself conditions.
But fear not! I happen to know about a device which will help you greatly: an AI-based, highly adaptable rocket control module, together with a top-notch accelerometer.
I know you can find the control module in Fort Observer, an abandoned military base not far from Murricaville. They used to work on sending things to space there, among other research. I cannot point you to a specific location, unfortunately. But I'm sure you'll find a way, Mr. Prepper!

I'm afraid we are both in trouble. Despite my precautions, there is a certain Agent who has taken interest in me and my recent... investigations. If he keeps snooping around, he might also get to you eventually.
But here's how you can help: you could put the Agent in trouble so he gets off our backs. This Agent lives nearby under the name of James FitzPatrick. 
Plant him an illegal item and I'll denounce him to the Agency.
It would be best if it was not simply illegal, but... illegal with a flair. To truly impress other Agents.
I have a feeling the postman would be willing to help with this. He's also not a fan of the Agency. 
Remember, Mr. Prepper, it's for our safety! Our ambitions are too grand to be thwarted by some petty agents!
Just a quick note: my source in the Agency tells me that the water usage will be added to the things checked during an inspection. Excessive use may be noticed. Please pay attention!

Heads up: as our great country has some problems with electricity supply, the Agency plans to start controlling domestic electricity usage. Keep in mind that high consumption may look suspicious. Take care!
A quick friendly warning: the Agency wants to ramp up the intensity of inspections. Be ready that they might want to look into your cupboards and prepare accordingly.

And here I am with another warning: some people in the Agency are determined to prove you really are up to something, and they will look into your cupboards and cabinets even more closely. Be sure to keep anything that might be suspicious out of their sight!

We took out the Agent, but the Agency has noticed my special interests anyway. I am in hiding now; I had to leave my job, house, and most of my things. I am not as well prepared for such situations like you, so I need to ask for your help. Could you send me some food? Preferably canned and long-lasting.
I also need to inform you of something you won't read in the Truth: the international situation is very tense currently. It seems the foreign powers have serious concerns about the real purpose of the Brazen Serpent satellite. It's hard to say how it ends.
Take care and don't forget about me, Mr. Prepper!

Thank you very much for the food you sent me! You are my inspiration and guardian angel, Mr. Prepper. 
This might be the last letter I am sending you and I have one final request. They are coming for me to my hideout. And I need to be prepared: either for forcing my way through them or making my last stand. For that, I need sufficient firepower. A regular handgun will not do.

Attention! As a result of an accident during military maneuvers, state high-voltage lines were interrupted. It is estimated that in the next few days the problem will be solved, however, the supply of electricity in some regions of the country may be withheld. If you have any questions or problems, please contact your local energy emergency services.

Citizens! The government informs. As a result of the failure of the nuclear reactor in our largest state power plant, some households may temporarily be deprived of electric power. We apologize for any inconvenience. If repairs will occur as a prolonged event, our functionaries will make sure that every citizen has access to food and drinking water. Stay prepared.

Meteorologists proclaim that next week will be exceptionally abundant in dangerous weather events, including storms. There may be power blackouts. Citizen, be aware! If there are characteristic signs in the sky, such as bright flares and rain and hail, stay home. If you are outside, take shelter in a nearby building or enter the car. Under no circumstances should you open an umbrella or stand under a tree.
Citizens! Due to a treacherous embargo imposed by the foreign powers, the upcoming week will be particularly hard for us. The import of goods is inhibited and this will negatively affect trade.

The local police informs that yesterday an investigation was initiated regarding the search for the missing Mr. Postman. We expect delays in the delivery of letters and other postal goods. All citizens who have been in contact with those missing in the last days are asked to provide information at the local police station. Remember, civic responsibility is the highest virtue.

This week the weather wasn't exceptional. As a result of periodic glaciations in the northern parts of the country, the integrity of our main pipelines was compromised. We can expect the delivery of water to be stopped in a few days. Our workers will take care of the crisis as soon as possible. Support them, citizens, and stay prepared.

The health service informs: citizen, drink only boiled water! There have been cases of serious illness after ingesting tap water. According to the local police and fire brigade, there are suspicious poisonous substances in the water. For further research and for the safety of our citizens, the supply of water will soon be cut off. We ask for your understanding. Remember! Your health is most important.

As a result of an unexpected accident, the work of the great state dam on the East Coast will be stopped. The dam's employees started maintenance and repair work in order to resume the unit's functioning as soon as possible. If repairs get drawn out, our functionaries will make sure that every citizen has access to food and drinking water. Stay prepared.

Discussion continues after the last week's shooting rampage perpetrated by a 27-year old man in Nottingham. Commentators draw comparisons to previous attacks in Kyoto, Malaga, Tehran, and Erfurt. Despite the different methods of attacks, in each of these cases the perpetrator had no criminal record and no discernible political motive, and they seemed to choose their victims at random. Moreover, all of the attackers exhibited a very unusual behaviour: they fell asleep shortly after their rampages, making arresting them very easy.
“The similarities are too striking to be accidental,” says Professor Clementine Montebello from University of Birmingham. “The profile of perpetrators and their modus operandi suggests a mind control technique of some sort is involved.”
Politicians are quicker to draw conclusions. “The attacks are obviously caused by the Brazen Serpent mind control satellite,” says Dominic Maralinga, the Foreign Secretary. “If the US administration does not shut down the programme immediately, there will be grave consequences.”
The White House has once again declined any comment on the matter.
International Pressure on the US Mounts after Nottingham Attack\n

As the beneficial effects of the Brazen Serpent satellite on the health and wellbeing of American citizens persist, the foreign powers continue to slander our flagship project. Lavrentiy Pervukhin, the Soviet Union's Chairman of the Council of Ministers, has sounded his suspicion that the Brazen Serpent is a "mass surveillance tool aimed at our citizens", and British Empire's PM, Gilbert Ellice, has called it "a dangerous experiment on the population of the US and other countries". The President staunchly opposes depicting the Brazen Serpent as anything other than a very effective medical device. He says the foreign politicians spread lies out of jealousy, trying to hide their own incompetence in providing security and healthcare for their citizens.
Who's afraid of the Americans' good health?

The regenerative and protective effects of the Brazen Serpent waves are already well known, but the new study conducted by researchers from New Mexico University Alamogordo suggests that they are beneficial also to pets, especially dogs. Animals that received a dosage of healing waves were more obedient and less aggressive than the control group. Increased purring (in felines) and tail-wagging (in canines) were also reported.
Brazen Serpent is also good for pets, study says
